batting.dismissal: c J Suchith b JO Holder

batting.name: NT Ellis
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b B Kumar

balls.text: they steal a bye last ball, and Kings end up on 125. Harpreet looks to swing this full ball outside off into the leg side, but misses. Saha throws the ball back, but doesn't hit the stumps
full delivery outside off, and slashed just past long-off's right. Rashid there runs and tries his best, but misses
walks across off, and hoicks that full ball outside off just between long-on and deep midwicket. The latter dives to his right and stretched out his right hand, but that still landed in the gap

tries to heave that, but can only slice to third man! Pandey takes a good catch running backwards. Bhuvi continues with that good length outside off, as Ellis goes for the swing to the on side but gets it off the outside half of the bat, as the ball is skied to the fielder, who is well into the boundary
wide ball now. Another good length ball wide of off which is angling away, and hence is called wide
just beats long-off! Lofts this good length ball wide of off from deep in his crease, and goes uppish as long-off runs to his right, but sees that go inside the rope
good length ball pitching wide of off, as Ellis has a swing at it and misses. Another change of pace ball from Bhuvneshwar
short delivery on middle, as Ellis looks to pull, but ends up tennis-batting it long-off after riding the bounce
good length ball and wide of off, pushed forward to long-off
full-toss on off, and hammered just short of long-on! Warner there dives forward, as the ball comes to him on the bounce. But with the ball hitting his left arm, he has stopped a couple of runs
and change of pace again. On a good length and outside off. Harpreet has a swing away from his body, but misses
a dipping low full-toss on off, which is almost a yorker. It almost took ages for the ball to come to Ellis, who waits for the slower ball before pushing it toward cover
that is full and in the slot on middle. He clears his front leg, but can only loft that to long-off with the open face of the bat
full ball and wide of off. A slower ball too, but that is too wide, as the batter watches it on its way to the keeper
lofted to long-off on the bounce. On a good length and again slightly wide of off, as Harpreet lifts that away from his body
pulls his length back on off, as Ellis pulls another slower ball to long-on
fuller ball and wide of off. This was an offcutter too, which the batter plays away from his body to long-off
slower ball this time. Pretty full and just outside off. Sliced to long-off
goes driving at this good length ball just outside off, but is beaten. The ball seemed to be angling away as well
good length ball and a touch wide of off. He skips down to push at that, but can only dab to the man at cover
shortish in length and outside off, turning away from him. Pulled to long-on from deep in his crease
comes back in off a good length, as it is pushed back to the bowler
low, dipping full-toss and chipped toward cover, but the ball lands just short of the man there
the one spinning away, and with some air given by Rashid. He looks to drive, but is beaten
turns away from him off a good length on middle, as he misses his poke
good length ball and wide of off. No turn there, as that is pushed to cover for another single
much fuller and just outside off. Taps that to cover and sets off for a quick single
short of a length and wide of off. Ellis goes for the poke, but doesn't get bat on ball

outstanding catch by the substitute fielder at cover! Leaps to his left and nabs that one-handed to send back Hooda, who tries to repeat the shot he played to Samad last over. Again he goes to loft that full delivery outside off over cover, but this time fails to clear the man, who files to his left to complete the take. Excellent catch to get a man who could well be impactful in the death overs
this is short of a length on leg, and he pulls to deep square from deep in his crease
another good length ball on middle, but this is angling away a touch. Clipped to the man at midwicket
good length ball outside off, and punched to the man at cover. There is a fumble by the fielder there since the ball bounced pretty high off one of the side pitches
goes inside-out over cover! Launches into this full ball outside off, which is in the driving length. Opens the bat face, and hammers that between deep point and long-off for four
full and outside off, opens the bat face for a single to deep point

full-toss on off, but right down to the man at long-off! It was tossed up, and so was dipping to the batter. Markram saw that coming and swung his bat, but seemed to have sliced that from the bottom of the bat to Pandey, who was into the boundary quite a few steps
shortish in length on off, and turning into him. Pulled to long-on
very full on off, and this time Hooda makes room to drill that to deep point for a couple
very full on middle, and crunched down to long-off after making some room
full ball on his pads, and a change of pace. Markram flicks, but the ball takes his front pad to trickle to the on side for a leg-bye
good length ball just outside off, and punched to long-off from deep in his crease
much fuller on middle and leg, and clipped to long-on with the angle into him. It was a cutter too from Khaleel
quick running this time. Pushed to the covers, as the man there dives to his right in vain
really full outside off, and drilled to deep point! Drives on the up as the ball is in the air for a second. He is deep in the crease, and creams that to the right of the deep point fielder
good length ball on middle and off, and angling away. Tapped to cover for a quick single
goes down on his knee early, and sweeps this full ball on off to fine leg
goes for the reverse-sweep to this full ball on middle, but the ball hits his front pad and rolls over behind square
the googly this time. Pitches on a fullish length outside off, as Hooda pushes that to long-on with the turn
low full-toss on middle, and again swept to fine leg after going down on his knee
good length ball and a touch wide of off. Turns away from him, as Hooda guides that toward short third man
full ball on middle, and turning into him. Sweeps that to fine leg after going down on his back knee
full delivery on middle, and straightens after pitching. Clipped from deep in his crease to long-on
slower delivery again. Pretty full outside off, and clipped to deep square leg

taken on the return by Sandeep after a bit of a fumble! That was nearly dropped, but eventually Sandeep has it in his hands. Pooran looks to hoick a full on middle and off, which is bowled with a change of pace. But he gets that aerially and off the inside half of the bat to the left of Sandeep, who lashes at it close to his left shoulder. The ball pops out twice, before finally finding a nest
crashed over deep midwicket! On a good length on off, and he hammers that pull with the free swing of the arms, and watches that go all the way for six. Could this start something for Kings?
pretty full on off, and clips to deep square. It was a slower ball too, at just 112kph
good length just outside off, and cut away to deep point
much fuller and just outside off. Markram closes the bat face to clip that, but instead rushes it back to the bowler for a dot
full delivery in the driving length outside off, and he drives full stretch to long-off

strikes his front pad, and Rashid gets what he wants after a cerebr-appeal! But Gayle reviews. Full delivery pitching on middle and turning into him to hit his front pad, which seems to be on leg stump. Meanwhile, Gayle is already halfway back on seeing that replay. UltraEdge confirms there is no inside edge, with his bat in front of off stump. Pitches on middle and leg, and hits middle and leg on top on umpire's call. And so Kings retain the review
goes down on his back knee to sweep this full ball outside off to fine leg
slower and fuller on middle and off. Gayle opens the bat face to run that down to short third man. A quick throw at the bowler's end means Gayle has to hurry
short of a length and outside off. Gayle dabs that to short third man from close to his body
good length just outside off stump. Looks to guide a late cut, but it finds short third man. Bhuvi there, it hits his knee, and rolls away
fullish on off and angling across. Stands tall and punches it through to deep extra cover
full on middle, and he works a flick off his pads behind square. Sharma runs in to keep it down to one
good length on leg stump. Bit of extra bounce. Worked off his chest to square leg for a single
full on his pads, and gently nudged off his boots to deep midwicket

good length on middle, and just going down the leg side. Gayle misses the flick, and wide is given by the umpire. Very interesting since that went down the leg side only because Gayle shuffled across to the off side
full on middle stump. Just a gentle push off the front foot, but that's enough for Gayle to earn a boundary. Races away with long on failing to cut it off
flighted, ends up as a full toss outside off since Markram presses forward to slog sweep over midwicket! Chance of a catch with the fielder inside the circle, but it has just gone beyond him
fullish on middle, and another ball that stays low while turning into leg. Hurries into a defensive push back to Rashid
overpitched outside off stump. He backs away to cut but the ball stays low and goes through to Saha. Well kept
flighted on off and he smacks a straight drive. Hit too straight - strikes the stumps at the bowler's end and the ball ricochets towards mid off
full outside off. The googly is driven to deep extra cover for one
length ball on middle and turning into leg. He moves away to make room on the leg side but the ball follows him
full on off stump. Slower ball to end the over. Smothers a drive down to long on for just one
back of a length on middle. Angling across and Gayle checks a pulled shot to deep midwicket
full on middle, and drilled to long on for one
yorker length just outside off. The drive takes an inside-edge to deep backward square leg
good length outside leg stump. Wants to drill a pull through the leg side. But mistimed totally. Ball rolls away to square leg for one
fullish ball angling into his pads. Pushed past midwicket's left to wide long on for one
fullish, just outside off stump. Pushed with the bat's open face to point

toe ends a drive off this full ball. Mistimed, and it's a catch for Warner! But it's been dropped! Warner runs towards the boundary line from cover to take the catch, but the ball goes over his shoulders and pops out of his hand

lofted shot and he uses the bottom hand to get it over mid off. Another ball that does not reach the boundary after going high in the air. This outfield is quite slow. Length ball angling across tries to hit it over mid off
fullish, just outside off. Goes for an expansive drive, but the ball goes just past the edge to the wicketkeeper
good length, on middle and leg. Defended back to the bowler
length ball just outside off stump, and punched to cover point off the front foot
fullish, on off stump. Pushed to cover, but no run taken.
good length, just outside off and angling away. Cut in front of square
fullish, just outside off. Another drive, the default shot, but the infield is packed on the off side
full, just outside off. Drills a drive, stopped at cover
just short of Saha! Fullish outside off. He prods forward to fend, and meets the ball with soft hands. Edged but it's a slow deck. Falls a couple of inches short of Saha.
fullish, just outside leg stump. Misses the flick, hits the pad and rolls away to the leg side
good length just outside off stump. Firmly punched to cover point. No run though

another one! And it's the other opener. Full on middle, and angling into leg. Agarwal goes for the drive, but he's in no position to execute it. Slices the drive, and its a soft dipping catch at mid off
good length just outside off and jagging in sharply. Shuffles onto the back foot and defends it to the off side
good length on middle stump, and worked off his hips to midwicket
full on middle. A gentle push off the front foot. Past the non-striker, and Williamson cuts it off at mid off

out first ball! Holder goes full just outside off. Rahul tries to whip a flick off his waist through midwicket. But mistimed, and not only that, it's been struck straight to the fielder at midwicket. The substitute Suchith grabs that, and Holder gives out a roar.
good length just outside off. Drags a sloggy shot to deep midwicket
lazy elegance! Full just outside off. Walks across to the off side, exposing all stumps, before scooping one gently over short fine leg!
full outside off stump. Looks to thump a big shot but sliced over cover. Ball doesn't go away to the boundary after hitting the grass. They take a couple more
good length just outside off. Takes the pace off and Rahul misses the square cut. Too close to his body anyway. Past the outside edge to the wicketkeeper
good length ball angling into middle, and clipped to midwicket
good length outside off. Gentle dab to cover point off the front foot
full on middle, and flicked to midwicket. Long on runs in to intercept
streaky! Good length just outside off. Tries to punch to mid off, but the outside edge takes it past short third man for four!
length ball outside off, and Rahul gets in shape to slap a cut. But the ball goes over the blade to the keeper
good length on middle. Rahul moves towards the leg side and then punches an inside-out shot to cover
good length just outside off stump. Punched straight back with the vertical bat on offer
good length just outside off stump. Mayank bends his knees and drags a flat-batted shot to long on for a single. Probably wanted to play it squarer, to the right of long on

good length just outside off stump. Punched square, squirts it through cover point. But Samad the youngster gives the ball a mighty chase and drags it back from inside the boundary. Applause from the keeper for the effort
good length on off and angling into leg stump. Flicked to deep midwicket for a single
good length, wider outside off. Cut square, beautifully timed, but Khaleel is committed to stop the shot. Dives from third man by running to his right, and cuts off the boundary
slashed and slashed hard! Good length outside off. Backs away and looks to clobber a cut through the off side. Ends up taking a thick edge over the slip cordon for four
good length just outside off. Fended back to Bhuvi off the back foot
fullish, outside off stump. Moving away. Looks to drive, but misses. Past the edge to the keeper. Minimal footwork, not to the pitch of the ball
back of a length outside off stump. Punched to the gap at cover point for another single. Tidy over from Sharma
fullish, wider outside off. Moving in, and nudged off the front foot to cover
full on off and swinging into middle. Driven to mid on's left, and takes off for the single. Holder runs around to cut it off. Has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end but no direct hit
length ball just outside off stump. Taps it off the back foot to cover point, and off they go for as ingle
good length outside off stump. Moving inwards again. Comfortably punched off the back foot to mid off
length ball outside off but moving into off stump. Carefully fended off the front foot towards Mayank

low full-toss on off, and that is ballooned to long-on on the bounce! It was a slower ball - an offcutter - as Holder closed his bat face to try and lift that, but knew it was never going far. Kings win by five runs. This is now the lowest IPL score defended in Sharjah
steps across off to this fullish ball wide of off, and slashes to long-off from the inside half of the bat
very full and wide of off. Really far from the batter, and wide is called
yorker length ball on off, and drilled to long-on. Holder refuses the single after Bhuvi is down for a run
short delivery and wide of off. Slower ball too, with good bounce there. Holder waits ages for it, before dabbing it to point
cracked over long-on! Holder keeping Sunrisers alive here. Free swing of the arms to this good length ball on off, as Holder rams that after clearing his front leg
on a good length outside off, and Bhuvi has a swing away from his body. It was a slower ball, as Bhuvi is beaten. But they still sneak in a bye, as Rahul misses his throw at the stumps at his end
yorker length ball on his pads, and Bhuvi clips that to fine leg with his front leg out of the way

makes room, and goes inside out! Finds the gap between long-off and deep point, as he lofts that good length ball on middle and off. Nice use of the wrists. Looked like they wanted only a single initially, but settle for two
short delivery to the new batter, and Bhuvi misses his late ramp. Again Arshdeep gets good bounce, as this one is pitched just outside off and Bhuvi is beaten
full delivery in the driving length just outside off, and he drives to deep point with the full face of the bat for a single
goes for the much fuller ball on off, which is angling away as Holder thinks of a poke, but withdraws his bat in the end

goes for the pull to this short ball, but skies that to Arshdeep! Rashid makes room to this ball pitched on off, with Arshdeep getting good bounce too. Rashid gets a top edge, as all the bowler has to do is take  a few steps to his right and sit under it
goes to slash at that short and wide ball outside off, but gets it off the bottom of the bat toward cover
hoicked on the bounce to deep square leg! Another full delivery in the slot on off, as Holder flicks that from across off stump
slower ball, and very full and outside off. Just inside the wide line, and so it remains a legal delivery as Holder let it go
misses his slog now. Slower ball and full outside off, as Holder is beaten this time
clears long-on with this slog! That was right in the slot on a full length on middle, as Holder clears his front leg to hammer that right down the ground
goes for the drive to this full ball on off, which is angling in. But he gets an inside edge, as the ball trickles to the left of short fine leg
beaten again! Holder goes for the slash to this good length ball just outside off, one which doesn't quite bounce too, as he tries to cut from close to his body
much fuller on middle and leg, and clipped to fine leg. Shami runs to his right to keep that to two
beaten on the outside edge! Good length ball on middle and off, and angling away with good bounce despite it being a cutter, as Holder has a poke, but doesn't get bat on ball
edged, but just short of third man! Good length ball a touch wide of off, and he flashes at that, but is not in control
slower ball on a good length on off. Pushed toward deep point

Saha is run-out after a terrible mix-up! He clips this full ball on his pads toward square leg, and set off. Holder wanted a second and had taken off immediately, with Saha not aware of what was happening at the other end. It was too late by the time he realised, but still went out of his crease to try and complete that. But by then, Bishnoi had already whipped off the bails
slower ball and a low full-toss on off. Pushes it back to the bowler, who throws it back to the stumps at Holder's end
Excellent running. Another change of pace ball from Ellis, as Holder clips it to deep square and completes a rapid two
short of a length on off, and he pulls that slower ball to the left of short fine leg
taps this fuller ball on off toward point for a quick single. 13 off this over already
six more! Slower ball on a full length on middle, and in the slot again. Holder waits for it come and cracks that over the bowler's head
whacked away over deep square leg! Length ball on middle, and Holder clears his front leg again to hammer that big and fine into the stands
good length ball just outside off, and turning in. Clipped from the back foot toward midwicket  while playing with the turn
clears his front foot, and smacks it back! That was tossed up on a full length outside off, as Holder cleared his front leg and sent that back hard and flat over the bowler's head
handsome ball! Completely beaten by this good length ball on off, which turns back into him and finds the space between pad and bat to just about sneak over the stumps
again bowls very full on middle, as Saha heaves that to deep midwicket after making some room
drills back this very full outside off between the stumps and the non-striker. Bishnoi dives to his right, but doesn't get a hand
Holder ramps that full ball on off to fine leg after stepping across to off, and bags two
full again, and straighter on off. Driven down to long-off with the full face of the bat
makes room to loft that full ball outside off inside out, but is beaten
fuller and straighter on off at 98kph. Driven back to the bowler off the back foot
on a short of a length on middle, which skids on too. Punched off the back foot to long-off
very full and just outside off. Low bounce again, and Holder pushes that to deep point
on a shortish length just outside off, and pulled to long-on from deep in his crease

flown off the leading edge to short third man! Samad goes to heave that full ball on off to the on side, but gets an edge, with the ball flying to Gayle, where he doesn't have to move to complete the catch. Sunrisers have now lost half their side
very full ball on middle and off, and clipped to deep square leg from across off

traps him in front, and appeals for leg before but not given! And Rahul reviews. Saha looked to flick this full ball just outside off which was turning in. Strikes Saha just near his front knee close to off, with his bat way outside off. So no chance of an edge there. Replays show the impact would have been outside off, and so the decision stays not out. Kings lose a review
this one turns back in off a good length outside off. Driven to long-on with the full face of the bat

chopped on! Jadhav looks to tickle that full ball outside off to third man, but the ball is too close to play that shot, as he gets a bottom edge on to the stumps to further send Sunrisers into trouble.
very full and wide of off. The ball keeps low, as he misses his slash with his bottom hand off too
shortish in length and just outside off. Cuts to long-off's left, from where Markram throws to the bowler's end but Brar couldn't quite collect it. That allows an extra run for Sunrisers
fullish and just outside off. Pulled from deep in his crease to long-on
fullish on off, and quicker as well. Doesn't quite get the bounce, as Saha pulls to deep midwicket
fullish on off, and clipped to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
Gayle dives over the ball at short third man, and the ball beats him. Jadhav cuts this good length wide of off, and bags three
goes to sweep this full ball on off, but is beaten by the turn away from him, as it strikes his body and balloons to the off side
full again, but pitches on leg and turns down further. Wide called
full delivery just outside off, and another googly. Pushed back to the bowler unconvincingly
and another one that turns in. Good length ball outside off, and chopped to short third man again
very full on off, and jammed back to the bowler, who fumbles and allows a single
googly no! Saha goes for the sweep to this full ball outside off, but is beaten
good length ball wide of off, as he stretches forward to a get it off the top half of the bat to short third
extra bounce off this length ball. Tries to cut but hits the bat's shoulder. Rolls away to third man
fullish, on middle stump. Ball stays low, and bunted down to long on for one
good length just outside off. Nice bounce, Saha has to tiptoe and fend towards cover point
cutter. Length ball on off and coming into leg stump. Misses the flick. Hits the pad and rolls away
good length outside off stump. Runs it down to third man
full on middle, and tapped off his pads to deep midwicket
good length, on leg. Nudged off his pad to square leg. An unusually big over given the game's standards. Seven off it
good length outside off. Backs away and cuts in front of square. Beats cover, and the man at long off needs to run to his left
good length outside off. Down on one knee and swept to deep backward square
full on middle, and flicked off his pads to fine leg. Played fairly fine but the fielder runs around the boundary to cut it off
full just outside off from around the stumps. Jadhav comes down the wicket and pushes it to cover
good length on leg stump. Worked off his pad to deep square leg

what a beautiful ball! Dream delivery for a legspinner who has the googly up his sleeve. Full just outside off. Pandey presses forward to flick through midwicket. But there's a gap between bat and body...and it's sneaked right through!
full on middle. Turning into leg. Worked off his pad to square leg for a quick single
flighted. Full outside off, and the googly is drilled to long off for one
wrong'un! Fullish outside off. Turns in as he looks to cut. Goes under the bat to Rahul
drags the length. Good length on middle, and skidding into leg. Thumped behind square with a powerful flick past the square-leg umpire
full just outside off. Down on one knee and swept to deep midwicket. No turn for this delivery
full, on off stump. Goes onto the back foot, and taps it to point.
flatter trajectory. Good length on middle and angling into leg. Mayank looks to work it to midwicket but misses. Hits him near the knee roll
good length, on off. Angling in with the arm. Looks to cut square, but mistimed. Ball rolls away to the off side
fullish, on leg. Angling further down leg. Rahul is slow to move to his left, and the ball rolls away after hitting his hand
continues around the stumps. Good length outside off. Cut after backing away. Mayank commits to the dive to stop any second run
full on off. Leans forward and tucks it off his toes to deep midwicket
full on off. Looks to work it leg side but a leading edge! Goes just over Brar and lands around mid off. Nobody there
good length, on middle. Late cut to short third man. This time Saha runs to the danger end, and therefore Pandey obliges. Sunrisers' lowest IPL powerplay score (six-over powerplays)
good length ball and nudged behind square. Short third man runs across to get to that
fullish, just outside off. Pace-off delivery, and a late cut behind point

good length on middle, and angling towards off. Swivels and pulls along the ground behind square. Fielder in the deep runs in and throws it near the stumps. But Saha successfully dives to complete the second
good length on middle stump. Rolls his fingers over the ball. Angling away, and a late nudge to short third man
fullish, on off. Bit of movement away from the right-hander. Tapped off the front foot
fullish, on off stump. Soft hands, defended back to the bowler. Just three off the over
fullish, just outside off stump. Slower one from Shami. Tapped to cover point
length ball outside off stump. Bit of lateral movement away. Saha looks to cut behind square, but no connection
good length, on off stump. Looks to whip it leg side but takes the top half of the bat. Chipped over the non-striker to mid on
full on off stump. Slogs this off his toes through mid on's right. But the shot doesn't have the pace. Markram runs towards the boundary line, and cuts the boundary off
back of a length just outside off stump. Extra bounce, and he is hurried onto a front-foot punch. Ball rolls away to mid off
another slower one to finish the over. Fullish, outside off. Tappedn to point, and Saha is off for a single, but Pandey is not so interested. Saha turns back and returns
slower ball. Good length on off and middle. Swivels to slog a pull to deep midwicket
quicker ball. Full outside off and jagging away after pitching. Looks to drive but past the outside edge
full, on off. Slower ball. Pushed to mid on's right with soft hands
keeping the pressure up. Good length ball outside off. Cut towards point, who dives to intercept again

starts off with a back of a length slower ball. Just outside off, but the cutter jags in. Looks to flick leg side but Saha misses. Hits the top of his pad and rolls away to backward point. Pooran runs around to try and get a direct-hit at the batter's end, but misses. Had Bishnoi not dived while backing up, that would've been four overthrows
length ball outside off stump. Nudges this to point with the bat's open face to point
full on leg stump. Looks to whip a clippy shot over square leg but the ball hits his pad instead
fullish just outside off but extra bounce en route to the batter. Defends after taking one hand off the bat, so plays it softly to the off side
fuller, just outside off but angling into the stumps. Firmly defended back to Shami. Collected on the followthrough

chopped on! Gets the big wicket of Williamson. Between a good length and full. Outside off stump. Willamson looks to punch it through cover, but the ball jags away inwards slightly, and takes the inside edge onto the stumps
fullish on off and angling into middle. Pushes a defensive shot to midwicket
around the stumps. But wrong line. Full and wide, and he helps it on the way for four with a lofted shot over cover
fullish, wider outside off. Opens the bat's face to run it down to deep point. Just past the infielder!
good length, on middle. Pulled off the back foot to deep midwicket
full just outside off. Straight drive comes off the bat's inside half. Rolls back to Arshdeep
full just outside off. Pushes at it off the front foot. Outside edge taken, and rolls away to short third man
full and wide outside off. And he crunches a drive past cover's left to the fielder in the deep
fullish on off. Trademark flick off the back foot to midwicket
good length on middle, and angling into leg stump. Wants to flick square, but misses. Hits the pad, but would've gone down the leg side. No appeal for lbw
fullish, on off stump. Williamson presses forward to defend it back to Shami

Warner's poor form continues! Length ball on off and angling further away. Definitely in the slot for Warner to cut it over point. But when it's not your time, it really isn't your time. Faint edge, and Rahul moves to his left to take the catch. Just the start Kings would've wanted
good length, just outside off. Wants to cut, but close to his body. Chopped on but just past the stumps. Short fine leg gives it a chase
good length, on middle stump. Rocks back and fends it back to Shami
